name: Arctium majus extract
description: Arctium majus extract (CAS 84649-87-6 ) is a botanical extract derived from greater burdock, used across personal care, nutraceutical, and food applications for its antioxidant and flavoring properties. Formulators source it as a functional ingredient where plant-derived actives are preferred over synthetic alternatives. In cosmetic formulations, it is incorporated into scalp treatments and tonics. It is also used in skin-conditioning products targeting sebum regulation and antioxidant protection. Nutraceutical manufacturers use it in dietary supplements and functional food products where burdock-derived bioactives are recognized. Food and beverage producers apply it as a botanical flavoring component, particularly in products positioned around traditional or herbal profiles. It meets various industry requirements for purity. Pharmaceutical and healthcare formulators include it in topical preparations and wellness products where standardized plant extracts are required. It is typically supplied as a liquid extract or dry powder. Standard grades include cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications, with some suppliers offering standardized extracts defined by active marker compounds. Packaging ranges from small quantities to bulk volumes. The extract is often processed to meet FCC or USP standards depending on the final application.
